videos.reviewMethod: Format-18 download. Stills at 1s, 45s, 80s, 105s, 135s, 160s, 195s, and 239s. Held slides compare at PSNR about 45 to 49 (45s vs 80s, 100s vs 110s, 135s vs 160s). observations.text: Slideshow of held images, not a moving camera. Sampled cards include an Arieki concept painting (1s), a waterfall settlement (45s and 80s), a first-person still with a weapon and three glowing emblems (105s, unchanged at 100s and 110s), a tent and a staff figure (135s and 160s), a figure facing a blue humanoid projection (195s), and the winged logo (239s). No HUD, names, or combat readout.
